issues.description: Method addGuestStudents(int): the problem statement UML declares addGuestStudents(int) with return type void, but the reference solution declares public boolean addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents). This mismatch between the UML/spec and the solution implementation (void vs boolean) will confuse students about the expected signature and behaviour (should the method return a boolean success flag or be void and only update the guest count?).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent across artifacts. Preferred fix: update the solution implementation to match the UML/spec by changing the method to a void addGuestStudents(int) that updates numberOfGuestStudents (and does not return boolean). Alternatively, if a boolean success indicator is intended, update the problem statement UML and task text to document a boolean return and explain its meaning.
